card.name: Commas inside combination drug names
card.fires_on: The comma after the first ingredient in a multi-ingredient drug name, mostly after 'sodium sulfate' in 'sodium sulfate, potassium sulfate, and magnesium sulfate'. It also fires on the start of a drug name that follows a list or prompt.

modes.label: Comma after first ingredient
modes.description: Comma separating ingredients in a combination product name, right after the first ingredient.
modes.example: Use sodium sulfate<<,>> potassium sulfate, and magnesium sulfate oral solution

modes.label: Start of a drug name
modes.description: The first piece of a drug name that is split into parts, such as Carb or Prom.

card.plain: It lights up on the comma that follows the first ingredient in a combination drug name, such as sodium sulfate, potassium sulfate and magnesium sulfate.
